review:
A post-apocalyptic western cluster slot. Five or more matching symbols touching up, down or sideways pay and vanish, and the gaps refill.

Sticky wilds, Boosters and Destroyers can kick in at any moment, which keeps the board unpredictable. Wild Spin guarantees a wild is dug up before each spin, for a higher stake. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and a 97% RTP, with free spins about once every 321 spins. Same DNA as Aztec Clusters, with a wasteland vibe.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 321 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
